title: Bowel obstruction and ileus in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the bowel obstruction or ileus (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/15/2026
Reason for Admission: Abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting.

Hospital Course:
Pt is a 56y/o F admitted with a partial small bowel obstruction. Imaging confirmed the obstruction was caused by adhesions from a previous abdominal surgery. Pt was managed conservatively with NPO status, IV fluids, and bowel rest. A nasogastric tube was placed for decompression. Pt showed rapid improvement in symptoms and abdominal exam became soft and non-tender. Bowel sounds returned to normal. Pt tolerated a transition to clear liquids and then a regular diet without complication. Stable throughout stay.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Partial small bowel obstruction
- Adhesions

Discharge Medications:
- Ondansetron 4mg PO PRN for nausea
- Multivitamin daily

Follow-up:
F/u with PCP in 1 week for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
05/15/2026
explanations: Intestinal adhesions with partial obstruction: K56.51 (HCC 78).
